rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
# Note: what we build here will not be installed, but is used to generate # the zone files in do_install below. make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" \ cc="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" \ AR="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-ar"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/zoneinfo" make \ REDO="right_only" \ TZDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/zoneinfo" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" \ zones
